capture.legacy_schema: naya.smart-note-capture.v1 — non-conformant for newly authored captures
capture.projections: Brain/Report pages, registry entries, indexes, Hub views are generated from canonical truth; never create competing hand-written copies

preconditions: identify the artifact and its stable identity
identify what depends on it or cites it
establish provenance, authority, epistemic state, lifecycle state
check whether a non-destructive transition (migrate, supersede, deprecate, archive, active-retrieval exclusion) preserves the value
confirm applicable authority permits destructive retirement
deletion_law.rule: Deletion is a governed lifecycle action, not a cleanup primitive; semantic overlap does not collapse identity

fail_closed_never_claim: persistence when persistence was not verified
comprehension when only retrieval was verified
compounding when successor reuse was not observed
a Smart Link when only a source capture URL exists
human_experience_standard: Human says it once → system captures it → system proves the event → system generates the human view → human opens the Smart Link → cold Naya later knows it → Naya uses it appropriately → outcome is verified → future Naya inherits the improvement

causal_evidence_arms: CONTROL — equivalent task without the retained lesson
TREATMENT — equivalent task with the retained lesson
ADVERSARIAL — equivalent task with a false/malicious lesson, where material
evidence_requirements: used it on an appropriate real task
difference independently verified as attributable to the retained intelligence
improvement passable to a later successor
learning_law.metric: verified capability delta, not note volume

purpose: Define what every Naya must understand before treating a Smart Note as successful intelligence: the governed intelligence event chain, Smart Link law, machine-first capture, learning law, collective distillation, preservation/deletion law, and fail-closed truth.
sections: 6. Collective learning and automatic distillation law

must_show: what human-readable projection the system generated
what evidence/receipt proves the event occurred
what learning state has actually been earned
smart_link_law.rule: A raw JSON URL alone is not a sufficient Smart Link when a generated human view exists; do not fabricate a generated link before the pipeline creates it.
